name: far-troll-goes-home-obstacle-route
description: D-174 (review): a full troll ~120 m from its hub with a 24 m line of player-built walls (two high) across its straight way - nothing it may break - must find a way round (the D-174 candidate search: 45 .. 135 degrees, up to 30 m), reach its hub and unload; no troll hit may reach a wall. The game's own path search may already route round the wall (run 174059: no detour was needed) - the test asserts the arrival, the delivery and that no wall was hit, not that a detour ran (the candidate search has its unit tests and recovery-walled-tree).
